entities.summary: The Palazzo Riso, officially RISO, Museo d'Arte Contemporanea della Sicilia and also known as Palazzo Belmonte Riso, is a regional contemporary art museum located in the ancient Corso Vittorio Emanuele, Palermo, Italy.
